info.description:
Disclaimer

Please note that SINGAPORE and TAIWAN are the prohibited territories.

All of 568Win's services will not be accessed from above mentioned territories.

Here is the information about Products territories.

  •  SBO Series Products - Prohibited territories : Singapore, Taiwan, Philippines.

  •  568Win Sports - Operated territories : Philippines only

  •  Other 3rd party products : refer to Third Party Providers Information

Please note that the demo environment does not support pressure test and has calling limit.

Overview

This API defines general guideline and set of function for integrating 568Win system with sports fund provider's system.

Company Key Policy

The Company Key is a security credential required for accessing 568Win system. To ensure security, each key has an expiration date, after which it will no longer work.

You can choose the key’s expiration period. In the back office system, under the page 7.3 System Parameter, choose the key validity period of either 30 or 90 days.

To maintain continuous system access, you must generate a new key before your current one expires. The new key can be created at any time through the back office 3.4 Company Key or API 7.3 Regenerate Company Key.

For all the APIs below, should use Company Key ApiType: Operation

Flow chart

Api Protocol

  1. All the API functions are request through HTTP POST.

  2. All the requests should come with Header

    1. Content-Type: application/json;

  3. All the responses are in JSON format

  4. All data in request and response are case sensitive.

  5. All APIs are based on timezone GMT-4.

item.name: 1.1 Login Flow
item.description:
Account Hierarchy and Configuration

The 568Win Platform implements a hierarchical account structure where each player must be associated with an agent. Player configurations, including currency and betting settings, inherit their default values from the agent's configuration.

Prerequisites for Platform Integration

To establish a successful login flow with the 568Win platform, the following components are required:

  • Agent Account

  • Player Account

  • Login URL

  • Redirection Parameters

Login Process

1. Agent Registration

Initiate the integration by registering an agent through API endpoint 2.1 Register Agent.

2. Player Registration

Using the registered agent name, create a player account through API endpoint 3.1 Register Player.

3. Authentication

After successful player registration, obtain the login URL by calling API endpoint 3.2 Login.

Important Notes Regarding Login URL:

  • Each generated URL is valid for single use only

  • Subsequent attempts to use the same URL will result in an error

  • The URL structure varies based on the Portfolio parameter specified in the Login API request

4. Customization Options

The platform supports various customization parameters for enhanced user experience.
For Sportsbook integration (refer to API 3.3 Login to SBO SportsBook), the following parameters are configurable:

  • 9.3 Themes

  • 9.4 Language

  • 8.2 Get Recommend Matches

5. Enter Game

Upon successful configuration of redirect parameters, players can enter the 568Win Platform through the generated login URL.

item.name: 1.2 Sync Bet Detail Flow
item.description:
For comprehensive bet detail synchronization, 568Win recommends implementing API 5.4 Get Bet List By Modify Date(Without Username) with a 30-second polling interval and a one-minute time window.
Please use max modifyDate at last response as startDate and max modifyDate at last response plus one minute as endDate in each polling.

Implementation Example

Polling Schedule

First polling time: 2024-11-11T12:00:00
Parameters:
- startDate: 2024-11-11T11:59:00
- endDate:   2024-11-11T12:00:00
max modifyDate is 2024-11-11T11:59:10.000
--
Senond polling time: 2024-11-11T12:00:30
Parameters:
- startDate: 2024-11-11T11:59:10.000 (first polling max modifyDate)
- endDate:   2024-11-11T12:00:10.000 (first polling max modifyDate + 1 mins)
max modifyDate is 2024-11-11T12:00:05.000
--
Third polling time: 2024-11-11T12:01:00
Parameters:
- startDate: 2024-11-11T12:00:05.000 (second polling max modifyDate)
- endDate:   2024-11-11T12:01:05.000 (second polling max modifyDate + 1 mins)
max modifyDate is 2024-11-11T12:00:31.000
--
Fourth polling time: 2024-11-11T12:01:30
Parameters:
- startDate: 2024-11-11T12:00:31.000 (third polling max modifyDate)
- endDate:   2024-11-11T12:01:31.000 (third polling max modifyDate + 1 mins)
max modifyDate is 2024-11-11T12:01:10.000

Alternative Method

For retrieving specific bet records, utilize API 5.6 Get Bet List By RefNos.

item.name: 1.3 Setting Sports Bet Limit
item.description:
Player-Level Sports Betting Limits Configuration

Agent Preset Configuration:

  1. API 2.3 Update Agent Preset Bet Setting

    1. Configures default betting limits for new registrants under the agent

    2. Does not affect existing players

  2. API 2.4 Update Agent Preset Bet Setting By Sport ID and Market Type

    1. Configures sport-specific and market-specific betting limits

    2. Applies to new registrants under the agent

Player-Specific Configuration:

  1. API 3.15 Update Player Bet Setting

    1. Sets individual player betting limits

  2. API 3.16 Update Player Bet Setting By Sport ID and Market Type

    1. Configures sport-specific and market-specific limits

    2. Username parameter accepts agent name to update all existing players under the agent

Mix Parlay Configuration:

  • Use parameters sport_type=0, market_type=40 (not sport_type=1, market_type=40) as mixed parlay spans multiple sports.

League-Level Configuration:

  1. API 4.1 Get League: Retrieves league IDs

  2. API 4.2 Set League Bet Setting: Configures league betting limits

  3. API 4.3 Get League Bet Setting: Retrieves league betting configurations

The token is considered as one time password for this login session and it will be expired in 20 seconds.

The Get Visible Matches endpoint retrieves a list of sports matches that are currently visible based on the specified parameters. This is particularly useful for those who need to display upcoming matches for users.

568Win system supports multiple currencies. However, one agent/ player account can only have one currency which is unchangeable once the account is created. For the agent/ player account's currency and their region IP mapping list, 568Win uses Maxmind GeoIP to recognize your region.

*Notice: According to the exchange rate policy, if the exchange rate of country Fiat Money is higher than the player's currency, player will not be allowed to access the products；if the exchange rate of country Fiat Money is lower than the player's currency, player will be allowed to access the products

Please note that TMP is required for use in all third-party product testing in the demo environment.

For VND and IDR, the exchange rate is 1:1000 on the 568Win system. That means 1 VND/IDR in the 568Win system is equivalent to 1000 real Vietnamese Dong/Indonesian Rupiah.

For VNO (Vietnamese original) and IDO (Indonesian original), the exchange rate is 1:1 on the 568Win system. That means 1 VNO/IDO in the 568Win system is equivalent to 1 real Vietnamese Dong/Indonesian Rupiah.

For MYK, the exchange rate is 1:1000 on the 568Win system. That means 1 MYK in the 568Win system is equivalent to 1000 real Myanmar Kyat.

item.name: 9.10 Sports Bet Limit
item.description:
The list of three kind of Bet Limits is for player account.

Bet Limit Type Description
Match Limit The bet limit by match, control by Trader.
Player Bet Setting The bet limit by player, control by player's Agent.

About Min./ Max. bets

Type Description Example
Min Bet Will be affected if it's lower than Currency limit It will takes the greater one between Currency Min. bet and Player Min. bet Currency limit : Min. bet = 15
Player limit : Min. bet = 10
Then the Min. bet that player will see on the ticket is 15.
Max Bet Will be affected by many conditions, as below :
- Odds Max. Bet (controlled by Trader)
- Match Max. Bet (controlled by Trader)
- Player Max. Bet
Most of the time it's Trader decision
But it will not exceed your setting of player Max. bet and Max. payout per match		 Currency limit : Max. bet = 15000
Player limit : Max. bet = 10000
Then the Max. bet that player will see on the ticket is 10000.

item.name: 9.11 BetStatus
item.description:
The first letter of the status for SBO Virtual Sports is capitalized, eg., Won.
The first letter of the status for Other products is lowercase, eg., won.
The first letter of the status 'Bonus' is capitalized for All Products.
Suggestion: Ignore the case sensitivity for status upon integration.

Type Description
draw Bet is draw and the stake is returned to player account.
lose Bet is lost and the loss amount is deducted from player account.
refund Refunded bets are those which in case to case basis are returned.
running Live bet has been accepted and winner will be determined at the conclusion of the event.
void Void bets can occur in a number of situations, where bets will not count, based on the applicable rule. When your bet is declared void, your original stake will be returned.
waiting Live bet is being processed but has yet to be accepted.
waiting Rejected Player places bet on live odds and trader rejects the bet due to many possible reasons, e.g. ball around the gate, corner is given, free kick... etc.
won Bet is won and the payout will be credited into player account.
done When the sub bet of Mix Parlay is refund, it shows 'Done'.
VOID(SUSPENDED MATCH) When the sub bet of Mix Parlay is void due to the match being suspended, it shows 'VOID(SUSPENDED MATCH)'.
Bonus Bet is a bonus bet and the payout will be credited to player account. Only some seamless game products have bonus bets.
Some seamless game providers may have the logic of won bet payout in Bonus status, e.g. Microgaming.

turnover Object Will have the turnover of each bets status : {win, lose, draw}
And will show on Response when the turnover > 0 .
E.g. When player turnover on lost bets is 765 and win bets is 192, will be
"turnover": { "lose": 765, "win":192 }
winlost decimal The Winlose of Player, do not include player's stake
commission decimal The Commission of Player.
totalDeposit decimal The Total Deposit of Player.
totalWithdrawal decimal The Total Withdrawal of Player.

Q : How to create a player to login game ?

Q : How to call report API to sync bet ?
